host_safety_learn_camera_p1: Hosts are required to disclose any exterior security cameras, doorbell cameras, or recording devices. You must describe their location and whether they are powered on during stays.
host_safety_learn_camera_p2: Cameras in private spaces (such as bedrooms, bathrooms, or indoor areas) are strictly prohibited.
host_safety_learn_noise_p: Noise decibel monitors allow hosts to measure sound levels without recording or transmitting audio conversations. Hosts must disclose all devices to guests before booking.
host_safety_learn_co_p: Carbon monoxide detectors protect guests against odorless, toxic gases. Many jurisdictions require working carbon monoxide detectors in rental homes with fuel-burning appliances or attached garages.
host_safety_learn_smoke_p: Working smoke detectors are a crucial safety feature. Check local regulations for requirements on smoke alarm placement and battery testing.
host_safety_learn_weapons_p: All weapons, firearms, and ammunition must be securely locked in a safe or secured cabinet that guests cannot access without host authorization.
host_safety_learn_children_p: If your space has steep drops, unprotected stairs, fragile heirlooms, or open balconies, indicate that it may not be suitable for young children.
host_safety_learn_infants_p: Indicate if your listing lacks infant-proofing, child gates, or has hazardous hazards that pose risks for babies under 2 years old.
host_safety_learn_animals_p: Disclose if farm animals, aggressive watchdogs, horses, or wildlife that could potentially injure guests or their pets are present on the grounds.
host_safety_learn_special_p: Share any unique property conditions that guests need to be aware of to ensure a safe and comfortable stay.

host_cancellation_footer_note_prefix: All standard stay policies include a 24-hour free cancellation period. Review the full policies in the
host_cancellation_flexible_b1: Full refund at least 1 day before check-in
host_cancellation_flexible_b2: Partial refund within 1 day of check-in
host_cancellation_flexible_info: Guests can cancel up to 24 hours before check-in for a full refund. If they cancel after that, you'll be paid for each night they stay, plus 1 additional night.
host_cancellation_moderate_b1: Full refund at least 5 days before check-in
host_cancellation_moderate_b2: Partial refund within 5 days of check-in
host_cancellation_moderate_info: Guests can cancel up to 5 days before check-in for a full refund. If they cancel after that, you'll be paid for all nights spent plus 50% for unspent nights.
host_cancellation_limited_b1: Full refund at least 14 days before check-in
host_cancellation_limited_info: Guests can cancel at least 14 days before check-in for a full refund. Between 7 and 14 days before check-in, guests receive a 50% refund for unspent nights.

host_cancellation_strict_long_b2: After that, the first 30 days of the stay are non-refundable
host_cancellation_strict_long_info: For stays of 28 nights or longer. Full refund only if cancelled within 48 hours of booking and at least 28 days before check-in. After that, the first 30 days of the stay are non-refundable.

host_local_laws_intro: Take a moment to review the local laws that apply to your listing. We want to make sure you have everything you need to get off to a great start.
host_local_laws_body_p1: Most cities have rules covering home sharing, and the specific codes and ordinances can appear in many places (such as zoning, building, licensing or tax codes). In most places, you must register, get a permit, or obtain a licence before you list your property or accept guests. You may also be responsible for collecting and remitting certain taxes. In some places, short-term rentals could be prohibited altogether.
host_local_laws_body_p2: Since you are responsible for your own decision to list, you should get comfortable with the applicable rules before listing on Homyz. To get you started, we offer some helpful resources under "Your City Laws".
host_local_laws_link_regulations_apply: What hosting regulations apply to you?
host_local_laws_legal_disclaimer: By accepting our Terms of Service and listing your space, you certify that you will follow applicable laws and regulations.
host_local_laws_art1_subtitle: Research local laws, taxes and permits.
host_local_laws_art1_summary: Before you start hosting, it's important to understand how short-term rentals are regulated in your area.
host_local_laws_art1_p1: Before you start hosting, it's important to understand how short-term rentals are regulated in your area. Local rules might affect whether you can host, what type of permit you need and which taxes apply.
host_local_laws_art1_p2: For example, there may be registration requirements and zoning rules that limit how you can use your space, or taxes such as occupancy tax or value-added tax.
host_local_laws_art1_p3: While Homyz can't provide legal or tax advice, we can help you find useful information to get started.
host_local_laws_art1_sec1_text2: about laws, regulations, taxes, best practices and other considerations for hosts. These guides are a starting point for understanding requirements in your country, state, county or city.
host_local_laws_art1_sec2_text: Many local governments publish short-term rental policies on their official websites. If you can't find the information online, try emailing or calling them directly. If you're a tenant, review your lease and check with your landlord.
host_local_laws_art1_sec3_text3: to connect with experienced hosts who've navigated local rules and regulations. Most hosts are not licensed tax or legal advisers; it's a good idea to verify any information you receive.
host_local_laws_art1_sec3_text4: A co-host could also help with licensing and permits.
host_local_laws_art1_sec4_text: Local lawyers or tax professionals can provide advice about the specific rules in your area; they can help you stay in compliance as you prepare to host.
host_local_laws_art1_sec5_intro: You can use AI tools to help identify regulations that may affect short-term rentals in your area. Keep these tips in mind for getting useful results:
host_local_laws_art1_sec5_tip1_text: For example, if you want to host in {city}, use the "City of {city}" in your queries. Otherwise, you might get results for the wider regional district, which has different rules.
host_local_laws_art1_sec5_tip2_text: The most accurate information typically comes from government websites. Local regulations change, so make sure you're seeing the latest.
host_local_laws_art1_sec5_tip3_text: Short-term rentals may be affected by neighbourhood, city, county, state, province, territory or country rules. Be sure to review all that apply.
host_local_laws_ai_prompt_template: What are the current short-term rental permits, zoning ordinances, registration requirements, and transient occupancy taxes for hosting a residential property in {city}? Please provide official government sources and municipal codes.
host_local_laws_art2_subtitle: Find out how Homyz handles unforeseen cancellations.
host_local_laws_art2_summary: Clear guidelines on cancellations during natural disasters, government travel restrictions, and declared emergencies.
host_local_laws_art2_p1: Homyz's Major Disruptive Events Policy outlines circumstances where hosts or guests may cancel eligible reservations with refunds, such as natural disasters, declared health emergencies, and government-mandated travel restrictions.
host_local_laws_art2_heading: What qualifies as a disruptive event
host_local_laws_art2_item1: Severe weather events making safe travel impossible
host_local_laws_art2_item2: Official evacuation orders or emergency declarations
host_local_laws_art2_item3: Widespread outages of critical public infrastructure
host_local_laws_art3_summary: Comprehensive host damage protection and liability insurance included with every booking.
host_local_laws_art3_p1: Every Homyz host receives comprehensive protection whenever they welcome guests. This includes damage protection, liability insurance, and 24-hour safety support.
host_local_laws_art3_item1: Up to SAR 3,000,000 in host damage protection
host_local_laws_art3_item3: Pet damage, art, and deep cleaning protection
host_local_laws_art3_card_sub: Top-to-bottom protection on damage and liability.
host_local_laws_art4_subtitle: Follow these responsible safety practices for peace of mind.
host_local_laws_art4_summary: Practical safety checklist including smoke alarms, carbon monoxide detectors, emergency plans, and first-aid provisions.
host_local_laws_art4_p1: Keeping guests safe is the cornerstone of great hosting. Ensure your space has tested working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, an accessible first-aid kit, and a clear emergency evacuation map.
host_local_laws_art4_item1: Install interconnected smoke detectors in every bedroom
host_local_laws_art4_item2: Maintain a serviced fire extinguisher in the kitchen
host_local_laws_art4_item3: Clearly display local emergency telephone numbers
host_local_laws_footnote: Information contained in this article may have changed since publication.

I grant Homyz permission to disclose tax-related and transaction information (such as name, listing address, tax amount and registration number) to the relevant tax authorities.
host_taxes_terms_error: You must agree to the terms to add taxes
host_taxes_learn_platform_p1: In many jurisdictions, Homyz has agreements with state, provincial, or local tax authorities to automatically collect and remit occupancy, tourist, or value-added taxes on behalf of hosts.
host_taxes_learn_platform_p2: These taxes are collected directly from guests during checkout and remitted by Homyz to the designated government authority. You don't need to take any action for these taxes.
host_taxes_learn_host_p1: If your local municipality or regional authority requires you as an independent host to collect occupancy or tourist tax that Homyz does not collect on your behalf, you can add that tax here.
host_taxes_learn_host_p2: Homyz will itemize and collect this tax from guests during booking, and pass the exact tax funds to you in your payout. You are legally responsible for submitting those tax proceeds directly to your tax authority.
host_taxes_learn_add_p1: You can add one or more custom taxes to apply to bookings of this property. Configure the calculation method (percentage or fixed amount), enter your valid local accommodation tax registration number, and agree to the remittance terms.
host_taxes_learn_partial_p1: Certain municipal laws specify that taxes only apply for a maximum number of nights (e.g. only the first 28 or 30 nights are taxable). Any subsequent nights beyond that threshold become exempt from tax.
host_taxes_learn_partial_p2: Enter the threshold number of nights to enable partial-stay exemptions.
host_taxes_learn_full_p1: In some jurisdictions, if a guest books an extended stay exceeding a certain length (for example, 30+ consecutive nights), the reservation qualifies as a residential tenancy and becomes 100% exempt from occupancy tax for the entire stay.
host_taxes_learn_full_p2: Enter the minimum stay length threshold to automatically waive the tax for qualifying reservations.

host_org_stays_card1_desc: homyz.org is an independent nonprofit organization that connects people in crisis with temporary emergency housing provided by hosts and funded by donors.
host_org_stays_card2_desc: Guests include individuals and families evacuated due to major natural disasters (wildfires, floods, earthquakes) or humanitarian crises (refugees and asylum seekers), as well as relief workers assisting on the ground.
host_org_stays_card3_desc: homyz.org works with established humanitarian organizations such as the International Rescue Committee (IRC), CORE, and GlobalGiving. These organizations assess guest eligibility and frequently manage reservations on behalf of their clients.
host_org_stays_card4_desc: Every homyz.org stay includes comprehensive Host damage protection up to $1,000,000 USD and liability insurance, giving you total peace of mind whenever you host.
host_org_stays_card5_desc: You are always in control. You review each homyz.org stay request individually before accepting. If you are unable to accommodate a request, declining will never affect your Superhost status or search performance.
